Name: Cozy Farmhouse Kitchen
Author: Alvadea
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZwFrjv5.jpeg[/img][/center]

[center][img]https://imgur.com/br9RloX.png[/img]

[color=#c9b490][size=3]This mod replaces the kitchens of the farmhouse and the island farm house with two complete new ones. Also the mini fridge is replaced. (If you don't like the island kitchen or the mini fridge you can toggle them of in the confic.)

You can choose between three kitchentypes. [b]Classic[/b] (white/light wood), [b]Gold[/b] (black/dark wood) and [b]Rustic[/b] (green/middle toned wood).
Also there are three different backsplash options. [b]Stone[/b], [b]Oriental[/b] and [b]Retro[/b]. Default is Classic with the Stone backsplash.

You can combine them as you like. Have a look at the pictures and decide which one fits your farmhouse most.

Enjoy! :D

[/size][/color][/center]

[color=#c9b490][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png[/img][/center]
